name: Notekraker
label: Bijzondere vogel
desc: 18:08-26 1 first calendar year foraging A bird with an abnormally elongated upper mandible (perhaps due to insufficient use during its development?) lands in a beech tree near us; it spends about 12 minutes foraging on the ground for beechnuts and takes a brief drink, before heading into the forest. At 18:26, a second individual flies in from the NW and lands in a patch of forest further away; it calls briefly, eliciting a response from the first bird, which then lands in roughly the same area.
